title: salvia cuspidata subsp. bangii
intro: Salvia cuspidata subsp. bangii, commonly known as the Bangi's sage, is a plant species in the Lamiaceae family. It is a shrub-like plant used in traditional medicine for its numerous health benefits, including anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Salvia cuspidata subsp. bangii include pain relief, wound healing, and the management of digestive issues, attributed to its bioactive constituents such as flavonoids, phenolic acids, and iridoid glycosides, among others. Additionally, its bioactive constituents have been found to exhibit potential anti-cancer and anti-viral activities, highlighting the plant's potential for the development of novel therapeutic agents.
